name: lettering
title: Lettering
description: Display titles in the script font with a riso print look: ink with a second color printed a hair off register. Pure CSS text-shadow, so the words are real text at any size. No gradients, no filters.

a11y: A real heading (or the element you choose): headings keep their level and outline. The offset color is decoration; the ink text has 14:1 contrast on paper.
Use one Lettering as the page's h1 at most; for repeated display text prefer p or span.
The riso offset is a text-shadow, so it scales with the text, follows the density knob (calm = none) and disappears in Windows high contrast.
